record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: OnSpawnEffect (per-entity instance with a stack counter) read by the MOUNTAIN_GALE ability
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.AVALUGG] is a factory that gives each Avalugg / Hisuian Avalugg entity its own BergmiteOnBackEffect (an OnSpawnEffect). When the entity is spawned it counts the Bergmite on the owning player's bench (row positionY 0) other than itself and stores that number in the instance's stacks (an assignment, so a second spawn would overwrite it); an entity with no player keeps 0. The passive does nothing else by itself. The units' skill MOUNTAIN_GALE (a separate ability record) reads the stacks on the caster's first cast only, caps them at 4 (MaxTroopersPerPkm) and adds that many extra hits. Outside the passive file, the count-evolution check also refuses to evolve a Bergmite while an Avalugg or Hisuian Avalugg is on the player's board, which keeps Bergmite available to sit on the bench.
triggers: OnSpawnEffect applied in Simulation.addPokemon when the entity is created: counts the bench Bergmite
MOUNTAIN_GALE first cast (count.ult === 0): reads stacks (separate ability record)

effects.declaredRaw: stacks = number of the owner's Bergmite with positionY 0 and a different id, counted once at spawn
effects.scaling: none; a plain count, no AP, crit or star scaling. The count is not capped here; MOUNTAIN_GALE applies the cap of 4 when it reads the value.
effects.resolution: requested/derived count = bench Bergmite at the moment of the OnSpawn call; applied cap 4 (MaxTroopersPerPkm) only in MOUNTAIN_GALE. No Big Eater Belt, Twist Band, heal, PP or shield helper is involved in the passive itself.

effects.declaredRaw: one extra MOUNTAIN_GALE hit per stack on the first cast only
effects.scaling: the hit amount and flinch belong to the ability record (40 raw special damage, 3000 ms flinch requested); this passive only supplies the count
effects.resolution: extra hits = min(stacks, 4) on the first cast (pokemon.count.ult === 0 read before super.process), 0 on later casts; they are added to the 1 / 3 / 5 / 10 star-based hits (both Avalugg are 2 stars, so 3 base hits).

effects.declaredRaw: Bergmite cannot evolve while an AVALUGG or HISUI_AVALUGG is on the player's board
effects.resolution: checked in canEvolve and canEvolveIfGettingOne of the COUNT evolution handler; it is a player-board rule outside combat. The Pokemon.final getter also excludes this passive from the 'final' shop rule.

conditions: the count includes only Bergmite whose positionY is 0 (the bench) and whose id differs from the entity's
stacks are counted once, at the OnSpawn call; Bergmite moved, sold or added after that do not change them
the bonus hits happen on the first cast only
record.resetBehaviour: New instance per entity (stacks start at 0); the OnSpawn call overwrites stacks with the current bench count. No reset after the first cast: the ability just ignores the stacks from the second cast on.
